title: Otori Emu — Helping You Show Thanks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
So excited about our shadowing☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you think we're gonna get to do?!
How cool would it be to help out with an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you two getting a little ahead of yourselves? We still don't know if we actually got spots with them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The company being advertised on that building's sign was also on the list of companies.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I think you're right.
Your eyes are so sharp, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew I'd seen them before somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I also recognized some of the other companies from that list. Why do you think that is?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is it possible that they're a part of the Otori Group? I know it's a big conglomerate that does a lot of other things besides running an amusement park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
I think I heard my brothers talking about them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, it's kinda hard for me to tell what they actually do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, isn't that pretty common?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm learning as much as I can right now for the sake of Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But I'm trying to learn how to operate a business. I should learn as much as I can about everything I can!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'll try asking Keisuke and Shosuke when I get home!)
A few hours later
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: —is how many guests we're expecting to receive this month, based on the data from last month.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: These figures aren't bad, but I feel like we're hitting a ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I agree. On the other hand, the park's satisfaction rating is showing a consistent upward trend. If things continue along this track...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uhh... Sorry, you guys!
Do you two have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Emu. How can we help you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, our school is having us participate in this work research shadowing program...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Interesting... You get to visit an actual company and receive hands-on work experience? That should be fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, and we're allowed to choose from this list of companies! Are any of them part of the Otori Group?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, a few.
Five in total if you include our affiliates. These ones here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, that many?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I mean, we keep our fingers in more than a few pies, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But if you're here asking us about our group's companies, then does that mean you're interested in visiting them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I've already made my choice!
I'm gonna visit a company called HeartUp Creation.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: HeartUp Creation?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're an event planning company! They run stage performances and town revitalization events and all sorts of other things!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This company must come up with lots and lots of fun ideas to make sure their guests enjoy themselves. So, I wanna learn about how they think and operate!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Sounds fine to me.
That viewpoint should help you down the road.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I agree. This is a valuable opportunity, so be sure to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Still, if you already had your mind set on a place, why ask about our group's companies?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I wanna learn about as many different companies as I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They might not have anything to do with how Phoenix Wonderland is run, but learning how they all think might help me in the future!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. Your diligence is admirable.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In that case, would you like to learn more about these companies right now? I'd be happy to give you a general overview.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, I'll pass for now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think doing my own research and asking you about what I learn would be better for me!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Well, well, listen to you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Then, instead of limiting yourself to our group, you should go out there and learn about as many companies as you can.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Especially the ones you're planning on visiting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to learn lots and lots about everything I can!
